title: mfa-recovery-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.admin.mfa-recovery-issue; exact inputs: tenant_id, user_id, reset_generation, approval_id, approved_recovery_channel, reason; initial state: MFA user has an existing recovery-code set and administrative reset requires a fresh recovery administrator plus independent approval

stimulus.const: Run identity.admin.mfa-recovery-issue for success, denial, failure, outage, replay, concurrency, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using tenant_id, user_id, reset_generation, approval_id, approved_recovery_channel, reason and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: regeneration invalidates every old code, one new code is consumed once, administrative reset removes factors and advances one generation only after approval, and recovery issuance binds that completed generation and approval while revealing no factor secret; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, denial=denied/forbidden, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: recovery_set_id, generated_code_count, consumed_code_count, old_code_rejected, reset_generation, independent_approval_count, recovery_capability_id, audit_event_digest

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: regeneration invalidates every old code, one new code is consumed once, administrative reset removes factors and advances one generation only after approval, and recovery issuance binds that completed generation and approval while revealing no factor secret; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, denial=denied/forbidden, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: recovery_set_id, generated_code_count, consumed_code_count, old_code_rejected, reset_generation, independent_approval_count, recovery_capability_id, audit_event_digest
